definitions: To strike repeatedly, especially with a hand, stick, or other implement.
To defeat (an opponent or rival) in a game, contest, or election.
To mix (ingredients) vigorously with a utensil.
To pulsate regularly, as a heart.
examples: He began to beat the drum.
Our team managed to beat the champions.
She needs to beat the eggs for the cake.
His heart began to beat faster.
They worked hard to beat the deadline.
